short_reflection_tr: Allah’ın rahmeti bütün varlığı kuşatır.
short_reflection_en: Wills goodness and mercy for all His creatures.

short_reflection_tr: Her zorlukta rahmet kapısı yine O’na açılır.
short_reflection_en: Acts with extreme kindness.

short_reflection_tr: Kalp, gerçek sahipliğin yalnız Allah’a ait olduğunu hatırlar.
short_reflection_en: The Sovereign Lord, The One with the complete Dominion, the One Whose Dominion is clear from imperfection.

short_reflection_tr: O’nun kusursuzluğu kalbe arınma arzusu verir.
short_reflection_en: The One who is pure from any imperfection and clear from children and adversaries.

short_reflection_tr: Huzurun gerçek kaynağı Allah’a yönelen kalptir.
short_reflection_en: The one who provides peace, calm and serenity. By citing this name, we declare peace for ourselves and for those around us.

short_reflection_tr: Belirsizlikte bile kalbi emniyete alan Allah’tır.
short_reflection_en: He grants faith, safety, and trust to His servants.

short_reflection_tr: Gözden kaçan hiçbir hâl Allah’ın korumasından uzak değildir.
short_reflection_en: Whoever dominates His creation and by His omnipotence in all aspects, no state or aspect in this world or the other escapes His will.

short_reflection_tr: İzzet arayan kalp, onu yalnız Allah katında bulur.
short_reflection_en: The Glorious by His supremacy and His greatness, El-Aziz means in a sense the one who is dear and precious in the eyes of His creatures.

short_reflection_tr: Kırılan gönlü de eksilen gücü de Allah tamamlar.
short_reflection_en: The grandiose, the ultimate powerful by His greatness and His unlimited strength.

short_reflection_tr: Kulun tevazusu, Allah’ın azametini tanımakla derinleşir.
short_reflection_en: Is superior to His creatures, no creature has the right to claim greatness.

short_reflection_tr: Varlığın her ayrıntısı yaratılışın hikmetini fısıldar.
short_reflection_en: The Creator of all existences, living or dead, mobile or frozen.

short_reflection_tr: Allah her şeyi yerli yerince ve uyum içinde yaratır.
short_reflection_en: Lifts His creation above all faults or imperfections.

short_reflection_tr: Her yüz, her renk ve her biçim O’nun sanatını gösterir.
short_reflection_en: The one who gives the look and the appearance to each creation from the inside as well as from the outside.

short_reflection_tr: Tövbe kapısını açık tutan Allah’tır.
short_reflection_en: Forgives what He wants to whom He wants.

short_reflection_tr: Hiçbir güç Allah’ın hükmünün önüne geçemez.
short_reflection_en: Is almighty to submit all creation to His will.

short_reflection_tr: Bazen en büyük lütuf, hiç beklemediğin anda gelir.
short_reflection_en: Gives immensely without receiving anything in return.

short_reflection_tr: Rızık sadece sofraya değil, kalbe de iner.
short_reflection_en: Makes distribute to every creature what it needs.

short_reflection_tr: Çıkışsız görünen yolları açan Allah’tır.
short_reflection_en: He opens what is closed and unlocks what is difficult by His wisdom.

short_reflection_tr: Dilin söylemediğini de kalbin sakladığını da O bilir.
short_reflection_en: The one from whom nothing can hide, for He knows everything and is aware of everything.

short_reflection_tr: Darlık anı da kulu Rabbine yaklaştıran bir derstir.
short_reflection_en: He withholds and constricts according to wisdom.

short_reflection_tr: Ferahlık da imkân da Allah’ın açtığı bir genişliktir.
short_reflection_en: He expands relief, provision, and ease according to wisdom.

short_reflection_tr: Kibir yükselmez; kulu yücelten tevazudur.
short_reflection_en: Destines the oppressors and the proud to demeanor and chastisement.

short_reflection_tr: Allah katında yükseliş, samimiyetle başlar.
short_reflection_en: He raises whom He wills in rank, honor, and nearness.

short_reflection_tr: Gerçek değer, Allah’ın yakınlığında bulunur.
short_reflection_en: One who offers honor and precious value.

short_reflection_tr: İnsanı koruyan, Rabbine karşı haddini bilmesidir.
short_reflection_en: Can humiliate and devalue any valiant.

short_reflection_tr: Sessiz dua da iç çekiş de Allah’a ulaşır.
short_reflection_en: He hears every sound and every prayer without missing a thing.

short_reflection_tr: Gizli kalan hiçbir hâl Allah’ın ilminden ve görmesinden uzak değildir.
short_reflection_en: Is the One from whom nothing that exists or comes into existence can escape without the slightest use of an eye, instrument or organ.

short_reflection_tr: Son hükümde şaşma yoktur; Allah her şeyi hakkıyla bilir.
short_reflection_en: He judges with perfect justice in this life and the next.

short_reflection_tr: Adaletin ölçüsü değişse de Allah’ın mizanı değişmez.
short_reflection_en: Is free from all forms of injustice and / or oppression.

short_reflection_tr: Bazı nimetler, ancak dikkat eden kalbin fark edebileceği kadar ince gelir.
short_reflection_en: Grants his creatures His gentleness and His benevolence.

short_reflection_tr: Görünenin arkasındaki hakikati de Allah bilir.
short_reflection_en: He is the One from whom cannot be hidden the reality of everything that exists, that is to say the truth of things.

short_reflection_tr: Allah’ın yumuşaklığı, kul için yeni başlangıçlara fırsat olur.
short_reflection_en: His forbearance gives sinners time to return and repent.

short_reflection_tr: Kalp, Allah’ın büyüklüğünü andıkça dünya küçülür.
short_reflection_en: His greatness is beyond every measure and every imagination.

short_reflection_tr: Affedilmeyi uman kalp, umudunu Allah’ta diri tutar.
short_reflection_en: Forgives immensely over and over again.

short_reflection_tr: Samimiyetle yapılan küçük bir iyilik Allah katında büyür.
short_reflection_en: Shows His gratitude for worshipers, however incredibly easy to perform.

short_reflection_tr: Kalbi yükselten şey, Allah’a yakınlıktır.
short_reflection_en: Is above all that He created perfectly and unimaginably.

short_reflection_tr: İnsan küçüklüğünü fark ettikçe Rabbini daha iyi tanır.
short_reflection_en: The Great: One who is greater than His creation, a greatness that only He knows.

short_reflection_tr: Bazen fark etmeden korunmak da büyük bir nimettir.
short_reflection_en: Protects and preserves His good.

meaning_tr: Her canlının rızkını ve gücünü veren
short_reflection_tr: Allah sadece beslemez; kalbe de güç verir.
short_reflection_en: This word is among the lost words of the ancient Arabic language.

short_reflection_tr: Kul için en büyük dayanak, Allah’ın yeterli oluşudur.
short_reflection_en: Will count all the facts of His creatures without forgetting or error.

short_reflection_tr: Allah’ın celâli, kalpte saygıyı ve edepli duruşu artırır.
short_reflection_en: Is perfectly exempt from being compared to His creatures or from being like Him.

meaning_en: The Most Generous, The Most Esteemed
short_reflection_tr: Allah’ın ikramı, umulandan da geniş olabilir.
short_reflection_en: Flooded His creation with His generosity.

short_reflection_tr: Murakabe, Allah’ın daima yakın olduğunu bilmektir.
short_reflection_en: Observes and beholds all that He has created (and the actions of creatures are also creations).

short_reflection_tr: Dua bazen beklenen şekilde değil, en hayırlı biçimde karşılık bulur.
short_reflection_en: Answers the invocations of His creatures if He wills and to whom He wills.

meaning_tr: Rahmeti ve ilmi sonsuz geniş olan
short_reflection_tr: Allah’ın rahmeti, insanın sınırlarını aşan bir genişlik taşır.
short_reflection_en: His vastness surrounds all things beyond what minds can measure.

short_reflection_tr: Anlayamadığın gecikmelerde bile ilahî hikmet işler.
short_reflection_en: He whose Wisdom has dazzled, dazzled and will dazzle any conscious and intelligent mind.

short_reflection_tr: Allah’ın sevgisi, kalbi yalnızlıktan çıkarır.
short_reflection_en: He draws near to His servants with mercy, kindness, and beneficence.

meaning_en: The Glorious One, The Most Honorable
short_reflection_tr: Allah’ın şanı, yaratılmış her övgünün ötesindedir.
short_reflection_en: Is glorified in the infinitely past, present and eternal.

short_reflection_tr: Umudu yeniden canlandıran da kalbi yeniden kaldıran da Allah’tır.
short_reflection_en: Raises the dead and deploys life in whatever He wants, be they men, animals or simply earth.

short_reflection_tr: Hiçbir emek, hiçbir gözyaşı Allah katında kaybolmaz.
short_reflection_en: He is the perfect witness over everything in His kingdom.

short_reflection_tr: Hakikati arayan kalp, sonunda yine Allah’a yönelir.
short_reflection_en: Holds the absolute Truth.

short_reflection_tr: Teslimiyet, sonucu Allah’a emanet edebilmektir.
short_reflection_en: Guarantees the sustenance of creatures and the One from whom nothing of their every state can be concealed.

short_reflection_tr: Kulun gücü tükenince, Allah’ın kudreti yeniden umut olur.
short_reflection_en: The Mighty: Allah is the most powerful, the strongest, his strength has no limit and is not described with definitions of physical strength.

short_reflection_tr: Dayanağın Allah olunca, kalp sarsılsa da yıkılmaz.
short_reflection_en: The Enduring: An endurance worthy of Him, unlimited, indefatigable, and which is not marred by any weakness, without pause.

short_reflection_tr: Allah’ın velâyeti, kulun yalnız olmadığını hatırlatır.
short_reflection_en: He lovingly protects and guides the servants who turn to Him.

short_reflection_tr: Şükür, Allah’ın hamde layık oluşunu fark etmektir.
short_reflection_en: Deserves the thanksgiving, the glorification and the song of praise more than any other.

meaning_tr: Her şeyi tek tek bilen ve sayan
short_reflection_tr: Gözden kaçan hiçbir ayrıntı Allah katında kayıp değildir.
short_reflection_en: He counts every creature, every act, and every detail without omission.

short_reflection_tr: Başlangıçların sahibi Allah’tır.
short_reflection_en: Gives a beginning to what does not exist without a beginning, without a model, that is to say, the One who creates creatures.

short_reflection_tr: Kaybolduğunu sandığın şeyi yeniden var etmeye Allah kadirdir.
short_reflection_en: Brings the living back to death after life and the One who brings the dead back to life after death.

short_reflection_tr: Toprağı dirilten Allah, kalbi de diriltir.
short_reflection_en: He brings life from lifelessness and revives whom He wills.

short_reflection_tr: Ölümü hatırlamak, hayatı daha bilinçli yaşamayı öğretir.
short_reflection_en: Kills living beings and the One who cancels out the power of the powerful of this world by death.

short_reflection_tr: Fanilik içinde kalbe hayat veren, Hayy olan Allah’tır.
short_reflection_en: He is ever-living, without beginning, end, or dependence.

meaning_tr: Varlığı kendinden olup her şeyi ayakta tutan
short_reflection_tr: Her şey O’nunla ayakta durur.
short_reflection_en: He sustains all existence while never being touched by change or extinction.

meaning_tr: Dilediğini bulan ve istediğini eksiksiz yapan
short_reflection_tr: Kayıp duygusuna karşı kalbi tamamlayan Allah’tır.
short_reflection_en: Does not need anything and is not reached or concerned with want, lack or need.

short_reflection_tr: Allah’ın cömertliği ve şerefi, kulun umudunu büyütür.
short_reflection_en: Is better than any other and the One who bestows innumerable benefits very widely and without compensation.

short_reflection_tr: Kalbi birleyen tevhid, insanı dağınıklıktan toplar.
short_reflection_en: The Unique: Is the One who has no alter ego, whether in His Being, in His Act, or in His Attributes. Nothing is like him.

short_reflection_tr: Allah’ın birliği, kalbin yönünü sadeleştirir.
short_reflection_en: The One: Is He Who has uniqueness as an attribute.

meaning_tr: Her şeyin muhtaç olduğu, kendisi hiçbir şeye muhtaç olmayan
short_reflection_tr: İhtiyaçlar çoğaldığında dönülecek kapı yine Allah’tır.
short_reflection_en: Is the One to whom we can rely for any business and who can be called upon for all our needs.

short_reflection_tr: İmkânsız görünenin sınırı kul içindir; Allah için değil.
short_reflection_en: Is unaffected by weakness, the One whose power is absolute and dominates all creatures and the One whom absolutely nothing can weaken.

short_reflection_tr: Allah’ın kudreti, sebeplerin sınırına bağlı değildir.
short_reflection_en: Is mighty over all things and the One whose capacities are absolutely limitless.

short_reflection_tr: Allah’ın öne çıkardığı şeyde bir hikmet vardır.
short_reflection_en: Is free from the characteristics of creatures and better than any creature.

short_reflection_tr: Geciken her şey mahrumiyet değil, bazen rahmettir.
short_reflection_en: Is free from the characteristics of creatures and better than any creature.

short_reflection_tr: Her başlangıcın öncesinde Allah vardır.
short_reflection_en: The First: Is the One who exists without creatures, without beginning and without time.

short_reflection_tr: Her şey sona erse de Allah bakidir.
short_reflection_en: Is the One who exists without interruption while the creatures are annihilated at every moment.

short_reflection_tr: Yaratılmış her şey Allah’ın delillerini görünür kılar.
short_reflection_en: His signs make His power and dominion evident throughout creation.

short_reflection_tr: Allah, kalbin en derin yerine de yakındır.
short_reflection_en: He is beyond the limits and likenesses of created things.

short_reflection_tr: Kontrol duygusu azaldığında, Allah’ın idaresini hatırlamak huzur verir.
short_reflection_en: He governs, manages, and orders all things with wisdom.

short_reflection_tr: Allah’ın yüceliği, kalbi dünyaya esir olmaktan kurtarır.
short_reflection_en: Is free from the attributes of creatures and the One whose power over creatures is boundless.

short_reflection_tr: Allah’ın iyiliği, kulun kusurundan daha geniştir.
short_reflection_en: He continually bestows goodness, faith, and blessing upon His creation.

short_reflection_tr: Her samimi dönüş, Allah katında karşılıksız kalmaz.
short_reflection_en: Grants forgiveness to those who repent every time they repent.

short_reflection_tr: Zulüm sonsuza dek sürmez; adalet Allah katında tamamlanır.
short_reflection_en: Is the avenger.

short_reflection_tr: Allah sadece affetmez; izi kalmayacak şekilde siler.
short_reflection_en: He pardons sin and keeps a door of hope and return open.

short_reflection_tr: Allah’ın şefkati, kulun en kırılgan hâline bile uzanır.
short_reflection_en: Can offer an immensity of benefits without counterpart and without necessity.

short_reflection_tr: Elinde tuttuğunu da kaybettiğini de Allah’ın mülkü olarak gör.
short_reflection_en: All sovereignty, dominion, and authority belong truly to Him.

short_reflection_tr: Allah’ın hem heybeti hem lütfu, kulluğu dengeler.
short_reflection_en: Is better than any other in reality and all the evidence confirms this and denies the contrary so it is not valid to dispute this point.

short_reflection_tr: Denge ve hakkaniyet, Allah’ın sevdiği bir ölçüdür.
short_reflection_en: He judges with perfect equity and is free from every injustice.

short_reflection_tr: Dağılan kalbi, kopan ümmeti ve günü Allah toparlar.
short_reflection_en: Gathers creatures together on a day of which there is no doubt, the Day of Judgment.

short_reflection_tr: Allah’ın zenginliği, kulun ihtiyacını O’na yöneltmesini öğretir.
short_reflection_en: He is free of all need, while every creature remains in need of Him.

short_reflection_tr: Asıl zenginlik, kalbin Allah ile yetinmesidir.
short_reflection_en: Satisfies the needs of creatures and the One who brings them their sustenance.

short_reflection_tr: Bazen verilmeyen şey de bir korunma biçimidir.
short_reflection_en: He protects whom He wills and withholds what would harm them.

short_reflection_tr: Sınav da kulu Rabbine yaklaştıran bir uyarı olabilir.
short_reflection_en: No harm reaches a creature except by His decree and wisdom.

short_reflection_tr: Fayda, Allah’ın dilediği yerde bereketle çoğalır.
short_reflection_en: Every true benefit reaches a creature by His decree and generosity.

short_reflection_tr: Kalbin yönünü aydınlatan nur Allah’tandır.
short_reflection_en: He guides hearts out of confusion and into clear direction.

short_reflection_tr: Doğru yolu sevdirmek de o yolda sabit kılmak da Allah’tır.
short_reflection_en: Intends for certain creatures the benefit of being well guided and of knowing righteousness.

short_reflection_tr: Allah’ın yaratışı, benzeri olmayan bir güzellik taşır.
short_reflection_en: He brings creation into being without model, matter, or precedent.

short_reflection_tr: Geçici olanı aşan huzur, Bâkî olana yönelmektir.
short_reflection_en: Is the One whose existence free from annihilation and change is imposed on sound reason which cannot claim the contrary.

short_reflection_tr: Dünya elde kalmaz; sonunda her şey Allah’a döner.
short_reflection_en: Exists and does not change as creatures are wiped out.

short_reflection_tr: Olgunluk ve isabet, Allah’ın yönlendirmesiyle güzelleşir.
short_reflection_en: Guides creatures to what is in their best interests.

short_reflection_tr: Sabır, Allah’ın kullarına açtığı merhametli bir zaman alanıdır.
short_reflection_en: He delays punishment and grants time for repentance before the appointed day.
